en: This cutie pie waits patiently in line and doesn’t ask much. The best kind of customer!
Nothing beats seeing a cheerful, smiling boy queuing patiently at our restaurant!
Business men have hectic schedules, so you can expect them to pay more for fast service.
These career ladies are willing to wait in line a bit longer, but will tip less.
He is half-way to becoming world famous, hence his cocky attitude. He pays good money though, so we should serve him with a smile.
International famous food critic! His reviews are usually harsh and he can really make or break a business. Loved by foodies, dreaded by restaurant managers.
Old, tired and full of interesting war stories. Listen to his stories as you serve him and you might get a generous tip.
Fairly patient and always in a good mood. Love her and she will love you back by giving you a generous tip.
Had training all her life to keep smiling no matter what happens, including when she has to queue very long. Does not tips as good, though.
A very famous figure back in his country, so he gets impatient when being told to queue. Will tip pretty good.
Has full schedule throughout each week, does not want to wait for long. Tips fairly good.
Made big money by chasing bad guys in action movies, he’ll tip very good if treated exceptionally well.
Being one of the richest people in the world does pay! She’ll leave if not treated well, but will tip lots when her high standards are met.
